entries.query: USE facts MATCH (a:Address)-[:HAS_FEATURE]->(f:AddressFeature) RETURN a.address AS address, f.tx_out_count AS tx_out_count, f.tx_in_count AS tx_in_count LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[:HAS_LABEL]->(label:AddressLabel) RETURN label.label AS label, label.entity_type AS entity_type, label.source AS source LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Address)-[:HAS_RISK_SCORE]->(r:RiskScore) RETURN a.address AS address, r.risk_score AS risk_score, r.window_days AS window_days, r.xgboost_model_version AS xgboost_model_version LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (n:NeuronEndpoint) WHERE n.netuid = 15 RETURN n.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id, n.coldkey_address AS coldkey_address, n.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, n.netuid AS netuid, n.ip_address AS ip_address, n.axon_port AS axon_port ORDER BY n.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[hne:HAS_NEURON_ENDPOINT]->(n:NeuronEndpoint) RETURN n.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id, hne.netuid AS netuid, hne.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, hne.ip_address AS ip_address, hne.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY hne.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[reg:REGISTERED_NEURON]->(h:Hotkey) WHERE reg.netuid = 15 RETURN h.address AS hotkey_address, reg.netuid AS netuid, reg.observation_count AS observation_count, reg.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY reg.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (h:Hotkey) RETURN h.address AS address, h.netuids AS netuids, h.observation_count AS observation_count, h.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, h.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY h.observation_count DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[:REGISTERED_NEURON]->(h:Hotkey)-[sf:SERVED_FROM]->(ip:IPAddress) RETURN h.address AS hotkey_address, ip.ip_address AS ip_address, sf.axon_port AS axon_port, sf.prometheus_port AS prometheus_port, sf.netuid AS netuid LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[op:OPERATED_FROM]->(ip:IPAddress) WHERE op.netuid = 15 RETURN ip.ip_address AS ip_address, op.netuid AS netuid, op.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, op.axon_port AS axon_port, op.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (ip:IPAddress) RETURN ip.ip_address AS ip_address, ip.netuids AS netuids, ip.observation_count AS observation_count, ip.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY ip.observation_count DESC LIMIT 25
USE facts MATCH (a:Address)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l:AddressLabel) RETURN l.label AS label, count(l) AS label_count ORDER BY label_count DESC LIMIT 25
